identitySignals: Keenan (the JPA's administrator) describes Northern California ReLiEF (NCR) as a non-profit, member-owned California joint powers authority providing risk-sharing for local educational agencies, matching the agenda's 'Excess Property and Liability Coverage' premium payment
An earlier OUSD board item (File 19-1280) records OUSD paying premiums for Excess Property and Liability Coverage to 'Northern California ReLiEF JPA', managed by Keenan & Associates, Torrance, CA
Agenda office is the Chief Financial Officer / Risk Management Department, consistent with an insurance risk pool membership
research.notes: Identity confirmed via Keenan page and OUSD File 19-1280. No contact details or registry IDs could be verified: reliefjpa.org renders only the word RELIEF to automated fetchers, the State Controller page returned 403, and the Torrance address/phone seen in a search snippet belongs to the administrator (Keenan) and was not confirmed on a fetched page, so it was left out. Legal name appears to be 'Northern California Regional Liability Excess Fund' per State Controller listing, but not verified on a fetched page.

profile.summary: Northern California ReLiEF (NCR) is one of two regional risk-sharing programs that make up the Regional Liability Excess Fund (ReLiEF). It is a non-profit, member-owned California joint powers authority that provides risk management and excess liability coverage to local educational agencies, such as school districts. Keenan & Associates acts as its administrator.

review.notes: Identity is plausible (Northern California ReLiEF is a non-profit, member-owned California JPA per the cited Keenan page, consistent with an excess coverage premium paid by Risk Management). However, the only cited source does not say Keenan administers it or that it provides excess liability coverage/risk management; those summary claims rest on uncited material, so the summary is not supported as written.
